air-shroud.note: Your kinetic aura provides breathable air, imposes a -1 circumstance penalty on ranged attacks whose paths pass through it, and is difficult terrain for flying creatures other than you.
air-shroud.name: Air Shroud

anchor-stance.note: Requires being in or under water; grants a +2 circumstance bonus to Fort/Reflex DC vs Reposition/Shove and to saves vs forced movement, limits forced movement of 10+ ft to 5 ft on a DC 11 flat check, and removes the need to Swim each turn to avoid sinking.
anchor-stance.name: Anchor Stance

requires.text: You're in or under water

arcane-cascade.note: Melee Strikes deal +1 force damage (rising to 2 with weapon specialization, 3 with greater) and gain the arcane trait, using instead the damage type of your most recent damaging spell if it dealt damage.
arcane-cascade.name: Arcane Cascade

requires.text: You used your most recent action this turn to Cast a Spell or make a Spellstrike

assume-earths-mantle.note: You become Large (+5 ft reach) with a climb Speed on earthen surfaces, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and +2 circumstance to Fort/Reflex DC vs Shove/Trip/knock Prone, and raise Strength to +4 (or +1 item bonus if already +4 or higher).
assume-earths-mantle.name: Assume Earth's Mantle

buckler-dance.note: Requires wielding a buckler; you constantly count as having Raised a Shield as long as you meet that action's requirements.
buckler-dance.name: Buckler Dance

requires.text: You are wielding a Buckler

bullet-dancer-stance.note: Requires being unarmored with a simple firearm/combination weapon; you may only Strike with bayonets, reinforced stocks, and simple firearms/combination weapons, and can use Flurry of Blows and other monk unarmed abilities with them.
bullet-dancer-stance.name: Bullet Dancer Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored and wielding a simple firearm or simple combination weapon

cenotaph-stance.note: Requires wielding a shield; you gain 10 temporary HP each turn, count as always having the shield raised, leave the stance if you move, and can Shield Block for allies within 15 feet plus gain an extra Shield-Block-only reaction each turn.
cenotaph-stance.name: Cenotaph Stance

requires.text: You're wielding a shield

channelers-stance.note: Energy-damage apparition/vessel spells you cast or Sustain gain a status bonus to damage equal to their rank, and vitality/void spells that restore HP grant a status bonus to initial healing equal to their rank (not healing over time).
channelers-stance.name: Channeler's Stance

claw-stance.note: The only Strikes you can make are frenzied claw attacks.
claw-stance.name: Claw Stance

cobra-stance.note: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC plus poison resistance equal to half your level, and can only make cobra fang Strikes.
cobra-stance.name: Cobra Stance

commitment-to-vigilance.note: All spaces within your melee reach are difficult terrain for your enemies.
commitment-to-vigilance.name: Commitment to Vigilance

covering-stance.note: At the end of each of your turns choose an adjacent ally to gain lesser cover until your next turn, and if you Intercept an Attack protecting that ally they can Step as a free action.
covering-stance.name: Covering Stance

crane-stance.note: Requires being unarmored, limits you to crane wing Strikes, reduces High/Long Jump DCs by 5, and extends Leaps by 5 feet horizontally or 2 feet vertically.
crane-stance.name: Crane Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

crowned-in-tempests-fury.note: Creatures entering or ending their turn in your kinetic aura take 2d12 electricity damage, you gain a 20-foot fly Speed, a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and your air Elemental Blasts deal +1d12 electricity.
crowned-in-tempests-fury.name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury

defy-hell.note: Requires not being unholy; grants a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects and lets you make Hellbreaker Strikes.
defy-hell.name: Defy Hell

requires.text: You aren't unholy

desert-wind.note: Creatures in your kinetic aura are Concealed from those outside and vice versa (except you), and your damaging air impulses hitting an aura creature deal +1 slashing damage (2 if single-target), scaling +1/+2 every 2 levels.
desert-wind.name: Desert Wind

devrins-cunning-stance.note: Entering requires a Deception check whose degree of success sets your marshal's aura effects: allies gain a +1 status bonus to skill checks and Striking an off-guard enemy stops it using reactions until its next turn (a crit success also enlarges the aura to a 20-foot emanation).
devrins-cunning-stance.name: Devrin's Cunning Stance

disarming-stance.note: Requires wielding a single one-handed melee weapon with nothing else in hand; grants +1 circumstance to Disarm via Athletics, +2 circumstance to your Reflex DC against Disarm attempts, and lets you Disarm creatures up to two sizes larger.
disarming-stance.name: Disarming Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

disruptive-stance.note: Lets you use Reactive Strike against concentrate actions (in addition to manipulate and move) and disrupt a triggering concentrate/manipulate action whenever your Strike hits, not only on a crit.
disruptive-stance.name: Disruptive Stance

divine-presence.note: Grants a 5-foot aura emanation you can act from any space within and Sustain to grow up to 15 feet, and an enemy ending its turn fully inside it is off-guard to your Strikes.
divine-presence.name: Divine Presence

dragon-stance.note: Requires being unarmored and lets you ignore the first square of difficult terrain while Striding.
dragon-stance.name: Dragon Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

dread-marshal-stance.note: Entering requires an Intimidation check; on a success your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to damage (or equal to your weapon's damage dice) and makes enemies frightened 1 when critically hit with a Strike.
dread-marshal-stance.name: Dread Marshal Stance

drifting-pollen.note: Creatures in or entering your kinetic aura (or ending their turn there) must make a Fortitude save vs your class DC or become sickened (1, or 2 on a crit fail) and dazzled while sickened, at most once per round.
drifting-pollen.name: Drifting Pollen

drowning-mist.note: Your aura is difficult terrain for creatures without a swim Speed and forces air-breathers to hold their breath, with a Fortitude save (vs class DC, max once per round) when they spend air or be sickened; you are immune to your own mist.
drowning-mist.name: Drowning Mist

dueling-dance-fighter.note: While in the stance you constantly gain the benefits of Dueling Parry; requires wielding a single one-handed melee weapon with nothing else in your hands.
dueling-dance-fighter.name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)

requires.text: You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands

dueling-dance-swashbuckler.note: While in the stance you constantly gain the benefits of Extravagant Parry; requires wielding only a single one-handed melee weapon with your other hand(s) free.
dueling-dance-swashbuckler.name: Dueling Dance (Swashbuckler)

requires.text: You are wielding only a single one-handed melee weapon and have your other hand or hands free

duelists-form.note: You are quickened (extra action only to Step or use a single-action Aldori duelist activity); using your free hand ends the stance, and ending it leaves you fatigued until you rest 10 minutes.
duelists-form.name: Duelist's Form

requires.text: You are wielding only an Aldori Dueling Sword and have your other hand or hands free; you are not fatigued

everstand-stance.note: Wielding your shield two-handed increases the weapon damage die of its boss/spikes by one step and raises its Hardness by 2 when using Shield Block; requires wielding a shield.
everstand-stance.name: Everstand Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a shield

fanes-fourberie.note: Choose to treat playing cards as daggers or darts and wield them as that weapon; lost/thrown cards can be recovered after 1 minute if most of the deck remains, and the deck can be etched with runes as a magic weapon.
fanes-fourberie.name: Fane's Fourberie

flair-rider-stance.note: While mounted and in the stance your mount always grants you lesser cover and you don't take the -2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves for being mounted.
flair-rider-stance.name: Flair Rider Stance

flood-stance.note: You hold your breath (up to 10 minutes) and can make only flooded river Strikes, which ignore the underwater penalty and gain the forceful trait while underwater; you don't lose air from attacking, being crit hit, or crit-failing a save, but lose all air if you speak or Cast a Spell.
flood-stance.name: Flood Stance

forests-heart.note: These reach-30-feet unarmed attacks gain no damage from striking runes but can benefit from the attack-roll item bonus and property runes of worn Handwraps of Mighty Blows; requires an attuned apparition granting Forest Lore or Herbalism Lore.
forests-heart.name: Forest's Heart

requires.text: Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Herbalism Lore as one of its apparition skills

geologic-attunement.note: You gain imprecise tremorsense in your kinetic aura (precise at 13th level) and once per round can Point Out a creature you sense with it as a free action.
geologic-attunement.name: Geologic Attunement

ghosts-in-the-storm.note: You and allies in your kinetic aura gain a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks, and after a move action become concealed with the shock rune on Strikes until the start of the next turn.
ghosts-in-the-storm.name: Ghosts in the Storm

golden-erinys-stance.note: On a critical hit with a melee Strike that deals piercing damage, the target becomes Sickened 1 (DC to remove equals your class DC), in addition to any critical specialization effect.
golden-erinys-stance.name: Golden Erinys Stance

gorilla-stance.note: You may only make gorilla slam Strikes, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Climb, with a success on a Climb check upgraded to a critical success.
gorilla-stance.name: Gorilla Stance

graceful-poise.note: If your second Double Slice Strike uses an agile weapon, Double Slice counts as one attack for your multiple attack penalty.
graceful-poise.name: Graceful Poise

haft-striker-stance.note: Requires wielding a two-handed hammer, spear, or polearm; the haft is a simple weapon that shares the main weapon's fundamental runes and can be treated as a second weapon for two-weapon feats, but you can't use two-handed-weapon abilities.
haft-striker-stance.name: Haft Striker Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a two-handed hammer, spear, or polearm

hampering-stance.note: Squares in a 5-foot emanation around you are difficult terrain for your enemies.
hampering-stance.name: Hampering Stance

immovable-object.note: While on the ground you are immune to forced movement, and an effect that would knock you prone instead fails and lets you Step as a free action.
immovable-object.name: Immovable Object

impassable-wall-stance.note: When you critically hit with a Reactive Strike triggered by a move action, you disrupt that move action.
impassable-wall-stance.name: Impassable Wall Stance

inspiring-marshal-stance.note: Requires a Diplomacy check to enter; on a success your aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.
inspiring-marshal-stance.name: Inspiring Marshal Stance

intensified-element-stance.note: Your strikes and damaging spells deal an extra 1d6 (2d6 if the elemental medicine was crafted by a legendary crafter) of a type keyed to the elemental medicine you expended against the corresponding creatures.
intensified-element-stance.name: Intensified Element Stance

requires.text: You were the recipient of elemental medicine (see Prepare Elemental Medicine) during your last daily preparations

ironblood-stance.note: You gain resistance 2 to all damage, increasing to 3 at 12th, 4 at 16th, and 5 at 20th level.
ironblood-stance.name: Ironblood Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

jellyfish-stance.note: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and on checks to Escape and Squeeze.
jellyfish-stance.name: Jellyfish Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

jesters-gambol.note: You ignore difficult terrain and gain resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt by animals, beasts, fey, fungi, and plants.
jesters-gambol.name: Jester's Gambol

requires.text: You are attuned to an apparition that grants Circus Lore or Fey Lore as one of its apparition skills

jotuns-battle-stance.note: A wielded two-handed melee weapon that lacks reach gains a reach of 10 feet.
jotuns-battle-stance.name: Jotun's Battle Stance

kaiju-stance.note: You become Large and Clumsy 1, ignore difficult terrain, and on a critical hit deal 1 bludgeoning splash damage per weapon die to everything within 10 feet of the target.
kaiju-stance.name: Kaiju Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

kindle-inner-flames.note: Grants a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks (+2 at 12th) and a free Step once per round to you and allies in your kinetic aura, and affected creatures' Strikes deal an extra 2 fire damage until end of turn after they take a move action.
kindle-inner-flames.name: Kindle Inner Flames

lunging-stance.note: You can make a Reactive Strike against a creature outside your reach but within Lunge range, increasing that Strike's range by 5 feet.
lunging-stance.name: Lunging Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a melee weapon

magnetic-field.note: Choose Attract or Repel polarity (switchable as a free action at the start of your turn): metal creatures treat your kinetic aura as difficult terrain when moving away from (Attract) or toward (Repel) you, and you pull or push unattended light-Bulk-or-less metal objects.
magnetic-field.name: Magnetic Field

masquerade-of-seasons-stance.note: Choose water, fire, void, or cold to gain resistance 5 (half your level at 12th+) to that damage type, changeable by using an action to reenter the stance.
masquerade-of-seasons-stance.name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance

mobile-shot-stance.note: Your ranged Strikes don't trigger Reactive Strike or other reactions triggered by ranged attacks, and if you have Reactive Strike you may use it with a loaded ranged weapon against a creature within 5 feet.
mobile-shot-stance.name: Mobile Shot Stance

monastic-archer-stance.note: Requires being unarmored and wielding a longbow, shortbow, or monk-trait bow; you may only Strike with such bows, can use Flurry of Blows with them, and can use monk feats/abilities requiring unarmed attacks with them within half the first range increment.
monastic-archer-stance.name: Monastic Archer Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored and wielding a longbow, shortbow, or a bow with the monk trait

mountain-stance.note: Requires being unarmored and touching the ground; grants a +2 circumstance bonus to defenses against Reposition, Shove, Trip, and other forced movement, and its AC bonus is cumulative with potency runes on explorer's clothing, mystic armor, and bands of force.
mountain-stance.name: Mountain Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored and touching the ground

multishot-stance.note: Requires wielding a reload-0 ranged weapon; your Double Shot penalty is reduced to -1 (-2 for three Strikes with Triple Shot), and the stance ends if you move from your position.
multishot-stance.name: Multishot Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0

orchards-endurance.note: You and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 (+2 per +4 levels) to bludgeoning and piercing and roll persistent-damage recovery flat checks twice, taking the higher result (fortune).
orchards-endurance.name: Orchard's Endurance

paragons-guard.note: Requires wielding a shield; you constantly have your shield raised as if you'd used Raise a Shield.
paragons-guard.name: Paragon's Guard

requires.text: You are wielding a shield

peafowl-stance.note: Requires a one-handed monk sword; you can make only melee Strikes with it, and once per round after a hit with a monk sword Strike you can Step as a free action as your next action.
peafowl-stance.name: Peafowl Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a sword that has the monk trait in one hand

point-blank-stance.note: Requires a ranged weapon; ignore the volley trait's attack penalty, or gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage within the first range increment with non-volley ranged weapons.
point-blank-stance.name: Point Blank Stance

requires.text: You are wielding a ranged weapon

powder-punch-stance.note: On your first melee Strike each round with an unarmed attack, knuckle dusters, or black powder knuckle dusters you deal 1 extra fire damage, and a critical Shove pushes the target 5 additional feet.
powder-punch-stance.name: Powder Punch Stance

push-back-the-dead.note: Grants an ally a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against undead effects and resistance to undead Strike damage equal to half your Charisma modifier (the +2 is to saves vs. undead, not AC).
push-back-the-dead.name: Push Back the Dead!

rain-of-embers-stance.note: Requires being unarmored; you can make only fire talon Strikes and gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
rain-of-embers-stance.name: Rain of Embers Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

ravel-of-thorns.note: Thorny hazardous terrain grows in your kinetic aura, giving creatures a -10-foot circumstance Speed penalty and dealing piercing damage (doubled on water/soil) when they move into a square; thorns disappear if you move and regrow at end of turn.
ravel-of-thorns.name: Ravel of Thorns

reflective-ripple-stance.note: Grants a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics for Disarm/Swim/Trip and a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex DC to avoid being Disarmed or Tripped.
reflective-ripple-stance.name: Reflective Ripple Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

ricochet-stance-fighter.note: Thrown bludgeoning/slashing weapons return to your hand after a ranged Strike within range increment (needing a free hand), enabling additional Strikes.
ricochet-stance-fighter.name: Ricochet Stance (Fighter)

ricochet-stance-rogue.note: Thrown bludgeoning/slashing weapons return to your hand after a ranged Strike within range increment (needing a free hand), enabling additional Strikes.
ricochet-stance-rogue.name: Ricochet Stance (Rogue)

rough-terrain-stance.note: Each adjacent square becomes difficult terrain matching your terrain attunement (which you ignore), and the stance ends if you move into a different terrain type.
rough-terrain-stance.name: Rough Terrain Stance

requires.text: You gained a terrain attunement benefit this turn

rushing-goat-stance.note: Ramming horn is your only usable Strike; if your prior action was Climb/Stride/Leap you gain a damage bonus equal to your number of weapon damage dice, and you can make it while Climbing without a free hand.
rushing-goat-stance.name: Rushing Goat Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

sea-glass-guardians.note: You and allies in your kinetic aura also gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws, and a creature critically hit or critically failing a save (staying above 0 HP) is healed as the impulse ends (d10s instead of d8s if in water).
sea-glass-guardians.name: Sea Glass Guardians

shattershields.note: Four floating plates each reduce physical-attack damage to affected creatures by Hardness 5 (destroyed if damage exceeds it), replenishable with a single concentrate action.
shattershields.name: Shattershields

shooting-stars-stance.note: You can use monk feats or abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with shuriken instead.
shooting-stars-stance.name: Shooting Stars Stance

six-pillars-stance.note: The +4 AC applies only against reactions triggered by concentrate or manipulate actions, and casting a spell that requires one or more actions grants your unarmed Strikes a +1 circumstance bonus to damage.
six-pillars-stance.name: Six Pillars Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

sky-and-heaven-stance.note: You can only make skyward slash Strikes and gain resistance 2 to electricity and sonic (increasing to 5 at 12th and 8 at 18th level).
sky-and-heaven-stance.name: Sky and Heaven Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

spear-of-doom.note: You can Strike the triggering enemy as a reaction whenever they succeed or crit an attack against you, gain an extra reaction each turn usable only for that Strike or Reactive Strikes, and your cursed weakness equals your full level instead of half.
spear-of-doom.name: Spear of Doom

requires.text: An enemy hit you with an attack dealing the same damage type as your cursed weakness within the last round, and you are Doomed 1 or greater

spell-network.note: Allies within your spellsurge aura can treat any other ally as a spell's point of origin (sharing touch range) and can redirect self-only spells to another ally in the aura.
spell-network.name: Spell Network

spiritual-spellshape-stance.note: Once per turn you can use a 1-action spellshape feat as a free action, but only to affect spells dealing spirit, vitality, or void damage.
spiritual-spellshape-stance.name: Spiritual Spellshape Stance

steam-knight.note: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed, can jump up to your Speed when you Leap (dealing fire damage to creatures you pass within 10 feet), and emit basic-Reflex fire damage to creatures in your kinetic aura each turn as a free action.
steam-knight.name: Steam Knight

stoked-flame-stance.note: You gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed (or an increased incredible movement bonus), and an alternate crit specialization can deal 1d6 persistent fire damage.
stoked-flame-stance.name: Stoked Flame Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

strategist-stance.note: Entering requires a Society or Warfare Lore check (DC = your level); on success your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves (crit success also enlarges the aura to 20 feet and can make a Recall-Knowledge target off-guard).
strategist-stance.name: Strategist Stance

stretching-reach.note: While wielding a two-handed melee weapon without reach, that weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.
stretching-reach.name: Stretching Reach

stumbling-stance.note: Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Feint, and an enemy that hits you with a melee Strike becomes off-guard against your next stumbling swing before the end of your next turn.
stumbling-stance.name: Stumbling Stance

stunt-performer-stance.note: Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and Escape checks and resistance 2 to all physical damage (requires being unarmored).
stunt-performer-stance.name: Stunt Performer Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

talon-stance.note: You don't need a free hand to make spinning talon Strikes.
talon-stance.name: Talon Stance

tangled-forest-stance.note: Each enemy in your reach that tries to move away must succeed at a Reflex save, Acrobatics, or Athletics check vs your class DC or be immobilized for that action (requires being unarmored).
tangled-forest-stance.name: Tangled Forest Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

tenacious-stance.note: Gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (min 1) and a +2 circumstance bonus to DCs against Shove and Trip, but you no longer negate the armor check penalty or Speed penalty from high Strength (requires wearing armor).
tenacious-stance.name: Tenacious Stance

requires.text: You are wearing armor

thermal-nimbus.note: Choose cold or fire; you and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance equal to your level to that type, and creatures starting or moving into the aura take half-your-level damage of the chosen type.
thermal-nimbus.name: Thermal Nimbus

tiger-stance.note: On a critical hit dealing damage the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed, and while your Speed is at least 20 feet you can Step 10 feet (requires being unarmored).
tiger-stance.name: Tiger Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

twinned-defense-fighter.note: You constantly gain the benefits of the Twin Parry action while wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.
twinned-defense-fighter.name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)

requires.text: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

twinned-defense-swashbuckler.note: You constantly gain the benefits of the Twin Parry action while wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.
twinned-defense-swashbuckler.name: Twinned Defense (Swashbuckler)

requires.text: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

twisting-petal-stance.note: You gain +1 circumstance bonuses to Athletics to Shove and Deception to Feint, plus +2 circumstance bonuses to your Fortitude DC against being Shoved and Perception DC against Feints; requires being unarmored.
twisting-petal-stance.name: Twisting Petal Stance

requires.text: You're unarmored

unified-stance.note: Your united companion (within 15 feet on entry) gains the Quickened condition and can use its extra action to Stride or Strike when Commanded.
unified-stance.name: Unified Stance

requires.text: You and your united companion are within 15 feet of each other

vitality-manipulating-stance.note: Vitality blast is a ranged unarmed Strike with a 30-foot range, and Stunning Fist can instead force a Fortitude save that leaves the target enfeebled 2 with disrupted manipulate actions (worsening on failure, adding a -10-foot Speed penalty on a critical failure).
vitality-manipulating-stance.name: Vitality-Manipulating Stance

war-rider-stance.note: Your dragon companion gains a 5-foot emanation aura that deals its support-benefit damage (basic Reflex vs. the mount's Athletics DC) to creatures starting their turn inside it.
war-rider-stance.name: War Rider Stance

waterfowl-stance.note: The dandpatta, scimitar, talwar, and zulfikar gain the monk trait for you, and Tumbling Through or Leaping over a creature while wielding one deals 1d6 slashing (2d6 with greater striking, 3d6 with major striking).
waterfowl-stance.name: Waterfowl Stance

whirling-blade-stance.note: All finesse melee monk weapons you wield gain thrown 10 feet, letting you make additional ranged Strikes measured from the prior target before the weapon flies back to you at end of turn.
whirling-blade-stance.name: Whirling Blade Stance

whirlwind-stance.note: Requires wielding your staff (which must have the parry trait) to enter and maintain the stance.
whirlwind-stance.name: Whirlwind Stance

requires.text: You are wielding your staff, which must have the parry trait

winter-sleet.note: Ice in your kinetic aura makes creatures that move on it fall unless they succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save (Stepping or Crawling is exempt, and you're immune), and a creature crit hit or crit failing a save against your water impulses becomes slowed 1.
winter-sleet.name: Winter Sleet

wolf-stance.note: Requires being unarmored, and while flanking a target your wolf jaw attacks also gain the trip trait.
wolf-stance.name: Wolf Stance

requires.text: You are unarmored

ursine-avenger-form.note: Your ursine form: a jaws and agile claws unarmed Strike. With Senses of the Bear, also low-light vision + scent 30 ft (darkvision if you already had low-light).
ursine-avenger-form.name: Ursine Avenger Form

dragons-rage-wings.note: While raging you sprout dragon wings: a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
dragons-rage-wings.name: Dragon's Rage Wings

animal-rage.note: Transform into your animal, gaining the effects of 3rd-rank Animal Form except you use your own statistics, temporary Hit Points, and unarmed attacks; you retain your gear's constant abilities, a frog's tongue reach increases to 15 feet, and dismissing the transformation has the rage trait.
animal-rage.name: Animal Rage

pesh-skin.note: While you're polymorphed into a plant, each creature that touches you or hits you with an unarmed attack or an adjacent melee weapon attack takes 1d6 piercing damage (2d6 if the polymorph spell is 8th level or higher, 3d6 if 10th), and any adjacent creature that deals you piercing or slashing damage must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or become stupefied 1 (stupefied 2 on a critical failure) until the end of its next turn.
pesh-skin.name: Pesh Skin

requires.text: You are transformed into a plant by a polymorph spell

devil-in-plain-sight.note: Your fiendish traits vanish and you appear as a typical non-tiefling member of your base ancestry (this counts as creating a disguise for Impersonate and automatically defeats Perception DCs to identify you as non-tiefling); while shapeshifted you can't use unarmed attacks, innate spells, or other abilities that require tiefling physical features, and you can remain in this form indefinitely.
devil-in-plain-sight.name: Devil in Plain Sight

final-form.note: Once per day, take on your final form for 1 minute with the effects of Divine Vessel for a deity matching your fiendish lineage's alignment; on activation each creature within 10 feet is deafened and dazzled 1 round unless it saves against your higher class or spell DC, while in the form you can cast Chilling Darkness, Fireball, and Lightning Bolt as 6th-rank divine innate spells (once each), you become Drained 3 when it ends, and while you have this feat you always have weakness 10 to holy.
final-form.name: Final Form

wings-of-air.note: Manifest feathered or cloudy wings for 10 minutes, gaining a fly Speed equal to your land Speed while they're manifested.
wings-of-air.name: Wings of Air

bone-swarm.note: Once per day, up to 1 minute (spend a single action to revert): you become Huge with the swarm trait; you're immune to grabbed, prone, and restrained; you have weakness 5 to area and splash damage; you can occupy other creatures' spaces and must do so to use your 2-action swarm ability, which deals 10d6 damage to every creature sharing your space (basic save vs your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). While in this form you can't speak, Cast Spells, use manipulate actions requiring hands, Activate magic items, or make Strikes with your normal body; you lack swarm mind (so you're still affected normally by mental effects) but retain skeleton feats that don't require communication or hands.
bone-swarm.name: Bone Swarm

bat-form.note: Once per hour, transform into a bat, gaining the effects of a 4th-rank Pest Form spell. At 14th level you can instead spend 2 actions to gain the effects of a 4th- or 5th-rank Aerial Form spell (bat form only).
bat-form.name: Bat Form

bodysnatcher.note: After you Consume Flesh of a creature your size or smaller, you can assume its exact physical form until you're no longer satiated (once per individual creature). This counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine your ancestry or creature type, and grants a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC against creatures trying to see through the disguise. You gain only the physical appearance -- not the creature's special abilities, skills, voice, memories, or other traits -- but unlike Change Shape you can take the appearance of a specific individual whose flesh you've consumed.
bodysnatcher.name: Bodysnatcher

rebirth-in-living-stone.note: Transform your body into living stone: gain 40 temporary Hit Points (50 at 20th level), immunity to critical hits and precision damage, and you can't be pushed, pulled, or tripped while standing on earth or stone; your earth Elemental Blasts deal an additional 1d10 damage of their normal type. These benefits last until the end of your next turn but can be Sustained up to 1 minute. After you gain the temporary Hit Points, you can't do so again for 10 minutes.
rebirth-in-living-stone.name: Rebirth in Living Stone

furnace-form.note: Transform into a living flame, gaining the benefits of the Fiery Body spell (except the ability to cast ignition) until the end of your next turn. While you Sustain the impulse (up to 1 minute) you can Fly up to half your fly Speed, and your fire Elemental Blasts deal an additional die of damage. At 16th level the duration is 1 minute, you can't Sustain the impulse, and you can Dismiss it.
furnace-form.name: Furnace Form

alloy-flesh-and-steel.note: You gain the benefits of the Ferrous Form spell (but can't cast needle darts) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute, Raising a metal Shield each time you do, and your metal Elemental Blasts deal an extra die of damage (the form's resistance is 15 at 16th level).
alloy-flesh-and-steel.name: Alloy Flesh and Steel

worm-form.note: You become a Huge worm battle form (animal trait): AC 20 + your level, 40 temporary HP, Athletics +30, and form-specific unarmed Strikes at +25 that are the only Strikes you can make. Purple Worm form: Speed 40 feet, burrow 30 feet, swim 20 feet.
worm-form.name: Worm Form

divine-wings.note: You manifest magical wings for 10 minutes (once per day), gaining a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
divine-wings.name: Divine Wings

rat-form.note: You gain the effects of a 1st-rank Pest Form spell, taking the battle form of a Tiny rat.
rat-form.name: Rat Form

long-nosed-form.note: You take on a specific human form until you Dismiss it: you lose your beak unarmed Strike and any other unarmed Strikes from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat, and the transformation counts as a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception.
long-nosed-form.name: Long-Nosed Form

form-of-the-bat.note: You gain the effects of a 4th-rank Pest Form spell, except you always transform into a bat. Frequency once per hour.
form-of-the-bat.name: Form of the Bat

animal-skin.note: Applies only while you are raging and unarmored. The item bonus to AC is +3 if you have the Greater Juggernaut class feature, and it stacks with Armor Potency runes on your explorer's clothing, Mystic Armor, and Bands of Force. This feat also increases your unarmored defense proficiency to expert.
animal-skin.name: Animal Skin

dragon-transformation.note: You gain the effects of a 6th-rank Dragon Form spell, except you use your own AC and attack modifier, apply your extra Rage damage, and Dragon Breath uses your class DC. Add Dragon Form's temporary Hit Points to any rage temp HP, and the Dismiss action gains the rage trait. At 18th level you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, your damage bonus with dragon Strikes increases to +12, and you gain a +14 status bonus to Dragon Breath damage.
dragon-transformation.name: Dragon Transformation

oni-form.note: Your size increases to Large and you become Clumsy 1; your Speed, reach, and other statistics are unchanged except as noted. Worn equipment resizes to fit. Using Oni Form counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception. You can Sustain it for up to 10 minutes, then must spend at least 10 minutes in your natural form before using it again.
oni-form.name: Oni Form

howling-aspect.note: For 1 minute you gain these two unarmed attacks. Frequency once per 10 minutes.
howling-aspect.name: Howling Aspect

among-humanity.note: Once per day, when you Change Shape into humanoid form, gain the effects of 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise for 1 hour or until you shift back — a polymorph effect rather than an illusion.
among-humanity.name: Among Humanity

towering-presence.note: Increase your size to Large until the start of your next turn (no effect if you were already Large or larger). Your equipment grows with you but returns to natural size if removed. You're Clumsy 1; your reach increases by 5 feet (or 10 feet if you started out Tiny); and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage.
towering-presence.name: Towering Presence

invoke-movement.note: While under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance, choose burrow, climb, fly, or swim; gain that Speed equal to your base Speed (or half your Speed if you chose burrow) for the trance's duration. Using it again lets you swap to a different movement type, but you lose the previous one.
invoke-movement.name: Invoke Movement

requires.text: You're under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance

a-little-bird-told-me.note: You become a Tiny bird (animal trait) and can't make Strikes. AC = 20 + your level; ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction. Weakness 5 to physical damage. Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers are +10 unless your own are higher; Athletics modifier -4. Dismiss to return to normal, or revert automatically if reduced to 0 HP.
a-little-bird-told-me.name: A Little Bird Told Me...

disperse-into-petals.note: You become an amorphous cloud of blossoms. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects/bonuses from armor, using your unarmored-defense proficiency instead; you're immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions with the attack or manipulate trait. Lasts up to 1 minute and can be Dismissed. Awakening: can last up to 1 hour. Awakening: you can occupy another creature's space and spend 1 action to spin in a vortex, dealing 1d4 slashing per 5 levels to that creature (basic Reflex save).
disperse-into-petals.name: Disperse into Petals

spirit-guide-form.note: Once per day, fuse with your spirit guide for 1 minute (end early as a free action); you can't use other actions from this archetype while fused. You become incorporeal. The resistance 10 applies to all damage except force, ghost touch, or spirit, and is doubled against non-magical damage. You gain only the one Strike — Claws or Jaws — matching your spirit guide type, and it's the only attack you can make: its damage is 3d6+5 slashing (Claws) or 3d10+5 piercing (Jaws) plus 1d6 force, and its attack modifier is +29 or your normal unarmed attack modifier, whichever is higher.
spirit-guide-form.name: Spirit Guide Form

vessels-form.note: For 1 minute you become Large with 10-foot reach (if you were Medium or smaller), gain a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls and a +1 status bonus to saves against spells, and 40 temporary Hit Points. With Entity's Resurgence active the attack and damage bonus rises to +3, and with the Entity's Strike feat that feat's unarmed attack increases its damage die from 1d6 to 1d8.
vessels-form.name: Vessel's Form

aon-wombat-style.note: 1-action monk stance (no printed Requirements). While in Wombat Stance the only Strikes you can make are wombat butt unarmed attacks, and you can't be flanked by enemies of your le
aon-wombat-style.name: Wombat Style

spellcasting-service.name: Spellcasting Service
spellcasting-service.price: by spell rank (≈ rank × level cost)

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.notes: Trained in martial weapons, Athletics, Intimidation, and Warfare Lore. Wields a falchion (1d10 slashing). When a berserker takes damage, it gains a +1 status bonus to its next damage roll before the end of your next turn (increasing as it advances).

medic.name: Medic
medic.notes: Trained in Medicine, Nature, and Herbalism Lore. Has the Battle Medicine feat and a healer's toolkit, and carries a scalpel (1d4 piercing).

scout.name: Scout
scout.notes: Trained in Acrobatics, Stealth, and Survival. Wields a shortsword and deals 1d4 extra precision damage to off-guard targets.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.notes: Trained in Acrobatics, Stealth, and Hunting Lore. Wields a shortbow. Take Aim (two actions): a ranged Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus to hit. A creature it damages takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round (-10 on a crit).

shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
shieldbearer.notes: Trained in Athletics, Survival, and Warfare Lore. Carries a shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10), can Raise a Shield (+2 AC), has the Shield Block feat, and gains a reaction when Directed.

normal-pet.name: Normal Pet
normal-pet.notes: Tiny; land Speed 25 feet; low-light vision. Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth scale with your level. Lets you choose two pet abilities.

aquatic-pet.name: Aquatic Pet
aquatic-pet.notes: Tiny; swim Speed 25 feet; low-light vision. Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth scale with your level. Lets you choose two pet abilities.

item-addiction-suppressant-greater.name: Addiction Suppressed
item-addiction-suppressant-greater.note: Addictions are afflictions whose ongoing save is a Fortitude save. Also suppresses that addiction's effects for the day without increasing the addiction DC.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against the ongoing save for the suppressed drug's addiction

item-addiction-suppressant-lesser.name: Addiction Suppressed
item-addiction-suppressant-lesser.note: Addictions are afflictions whose ongoing save is a Fortitude save, so the bonus is targeted there. For the same day it also suppresses that addiction's effects as if you'd taken a dose, without the drug's effects and without raising the addiction DC.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against the ongoing save for the suppressed drug's addiction

item-addiction-suppressant-major.name: Addiction Suppressed
item-addiction-suppressant-major.note: Addictions are afflictions whose ongoing save is a Fortitude save. Also suppresses that addiction's effects for the day without increasing the addiction DC.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against the ongoing save for the suppressed drug's addiction

item-addiction-suppressant-moderate.name: Addiction Suppressed
item-addiction-suppressant-moderate.note: Addictions are afflictions whose ongoing save is a Fortitude save. Also suppresses that addiction's effects for the day without increasing the addiction DC.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against the ongoing save for the suppressed drug's addiction

item-affliction-suppressant-greater.name: Affliction Suppressant
item-affliction-suppressant-greater.note: Doesn't apply to a daily save against a disease or curse; it covers initial exposure and saves from stages of 10 minutes or less.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions

item-affliction-suppressant-lesser.name: Affliction Suppressant
item-affliction-suppressant-lesser.note: Too short-lived to apply to a daily save against a disease or curse; it covers initial exposure and saves from stages of 10 minutes or less.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions

item-affliction-suppressant-major.name: Affliction Suppressant
item-affliction-suppressant-major.note: On drinking it you may attempt a save against one affliction of 14th level or lower affecting you; on a success its symptoms are suppressed for 10 minutes without its duration elapsing. Doesn't apply to a daily save against a disease or curse.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions

item-affliction-suppressant-moderate.name: Affliction Suppressant
item-affliction-suppressant-moderate.note: Doesn't apply to a daily save against a disease or curse; it covers initial exposure and saves from stages of 10 minutes or less.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions

item-animal-turning-fulu.name: Concealed from Beast
item-animal-turning-fulu.duration: until the start of your next turn
item-animal-turning-fulu.note: The +2 item bonus to AC is against the triggering Strike only — one roll, not a duration, so it is not a sheet modifier. The lasting part is concealment from that one creature until the start of your next turn.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons
against poisons

item-antidote-major.name: Antidote
item-antidote-major.note: On drinking, immediately attempt a save against one poison of 14th level or lower affecting you; on a success it is neutralized (one-time, not part of the ongoing mode).

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons
against poisons

item-antifungal-salve-greater.name: Antifungal Salve (Greater)
item-antifungal-salve-greater.note: Duration is stated in the following sentence: "The bonus lasts for 6 hours."

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures

item-antifungal-salve-lesser.name: Antifungal Salve (Lesser)
item-antifungal-salve-lesser.note: Duration is stated in the following sentence: "The bonus lasts for 6 hours."

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures

item-antifungal-salve-major.name: Antifungal Salve (Major)
item-antifungal-salve-major.note: Duration is stated in the following sentence: "The bonus lasts for 6 hours." On application only, the target may immediately attempt a save against one fungal affliction of 14th level or lower affecting them; on a success the affliction is neutralized — a one-shot cure outside the mode.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures

item-antifungal-salve-moderate.name: Antifungal Salve (Moderate)
item-antifungal-salve-moderate.note: Duration is stated in the following sentence: "The bonus lasts for 6 hours."

modifiers.appliesWhen: against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures
against afflictions with the fungus trait or from fungus creatures

item-antiplague-greater.name: Antiplague
item-antiplague-greater.note: Applies to the daily save against a disease's progression.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against diseases

item-antiplague-lesser.name: Antiplague
item-antiplague-lesser.note: Applies to the daily save against a disease's progression.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against diseases

item-antiplague-major.name: Antiplague

item-silver-crescent-lesser.note: You shed cool white light like a torch. While shedding it you can't be concealed if you're visible, and if you're invisible you're concealed rather than undetected. Secondary Effect (light ray at a distant square) affects other creatures and makes the crescent inert.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against olfactory effects

item-silver-crescent-moderate.name: Silver Crescent (Moderate)
item-silver-crescent-moderate.note: You shed cool white light like a torch. While shedding it you can't be concealed if you're visible, and if you're invisible you're concealed rather than undetected. Secondary Effect (light ray) affects other creatures and makes the crescent inert.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against olfactory effects

item-silvertongue-mutagen-greater.name: Silvertongue Mutagen
item-silvertongue-mutagen-greater.note: The -2 item penalty ALSO applies to every Lore skill - apply it by hand (skill modifiers are keyed per-Lore, e.g. lore:warfare, so a blanket Lore penalty cannot be encoded). Critical failures with Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance become failures instead. Choose one skill you are trained in; you become untrained in it for the duration. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

item-silvertongue-mutagen-lesser.name: Silvertongue Mutagen
item-silvertongue-mutagen-lesser.note: The -2 item penalty ALSO applies to every Lore skill - apply it by hand (skill modifiers are keyed per-Lore, e.g. lore:warfare, so a blanket Lore penalty cannot be encoded). Critical failures with Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance become failures instead. Choose one skill you are trained in; you become untrained in it for the duration. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

item-silvertongue-mutagen-major.name: Silvertongue Mutagen
item-silvertongue-mutagen-major.note: The -2 item penalty ALSO applies to every Lore skill - apply it by hand (skill modifiers are keyed per-Lore, e.g. lore:warfare, so a blanket Lore penalty cannot be encoded). Critical failures with Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance become failures instead. Choose one skill you are trained in; you become untrained in it for the duration. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

item-silvertongue-mutagen-moderate.name: Silvertongue Mutagen
item-silvertongue-mutagen-moderate.note: The -2 item penalty ALSO applies to every Lore skill - apply it by hand (skill modifiers are keyed per-Lore, e.g. lore:warfare, so a blanket Lore penalty cannot be encoded). Critical failures with Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance become failures instead. Choose one skill you are trained in; you become untrained in it for the duration. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

item-sneaky-key.name: Sneaky Key
item-sneaky-key.note: Requires you to be trained in Thievery. The first time you get a success or critical success to Pick a Lock, you achieve one additional success toward opening a complex lock.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Pick a Lock

item-soothing-toddy.name: Soothing Toddy
item-soothing-toddy.note: The second bonus covers only ONE trait, fixed when the toddy was made: Amaretto = auditory, Limoncello = olfactory, Whiskey = visual.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against emotion effects
against effects with the liquor's trait (Amaretto = auditory, Limoncello = olfactory, Whiskey = visual)

item-spiderfoot-brew-greater.name: Spiderfoot (Greater)
item-spiderfoot-brew-greater.note: You also gain a climb Speed of 25 feet for the duration.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on Athletics checks to Climb

item-spiderfoot-brew-lesser.name: Spiderfoot (Lesser)
item-spiderfoot-brew-lesser.note: You also gain a climb Speed of 15 feet for the duration.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on Athletics checks to Climb

item-spiderfoot-brew-moderate.name: Spiderfoot (Moderate)
item-spiderfoot-brew-moderate.note: You also gain a climb Speed of 20 feet for the duration.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on Athletics checks to Climb

item-spiritsight-tea.name: Spiritsight Tea
item-spiritsight-tea.duration: 10 minutes (with the Tea Ceremony: 30 minutes of seeing invisible, 8 hours of the item bonus)
item-spiritsight-tea.note: Display side of the same mode: for 10 minutes you can see invisible creatures and objects (they appear as translucent shapes and are concealed to you), your eyes glow softly, and the tea sheds candlelight. The Tea Ceremony activation raises see-invisible to 30 minutes and the item bonus to 8 hours.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on checks to Seek incorporeal creatures

item-sprite-apple-chartreuse.name: Sprite Apple (Chartreuse)
item-sprite-apple-chartreuse.note: Duration/light: "For 10 minutes after consuming a sprite apple, you shed bright light in a [emanation] (and dim light for the next 20 feet)." The bonus is granted to every creature standing in that bright light, allies and enemies alike, not to you exclusively. While shedding the light you can't be concealed if you're visible, and if you're invisible you're concealed rather than undetected.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against animals or plants, and only with Animal Empathy, Plant Empathy, or a similar ability

item-sprite-apple-pink.name: Sprite Apple (Pink)
item-sprite-apple-pink.note: Duration/light: "For 10 minutes after consuming a sprite apple, you shed bright light in a [emanation] (and dim light for the next 20 feet)." Every creature in the bright light gets the bonus, not just you. While shedding the light you can't be concealed if you're visible, and if you're invisible you're concealed rather than undetected.

item-sprite-apple-teal.name: Sprite Apple (Teal)
item-sprite-apple-teal.note: Duration/light: "For 10 minutes after consuming a sprite apple, you shed bright light in a [emanation] (and dim light for the next 20 feet)." Every creature in the bright light gets the bonus, not just you. While shedding the light you can't be concealed if you're visible, and if you're invisible you're concealed rather than undetected.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against fear effects

item-star-of-cynosure.name: Star of Cynosure
item-star-of-cynosure.note: Separately, on the triggering Will save only, a failure becomes a success and a critical failure becomes a failure — a one-shot upgrade, not part of the ongoing bonus.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against spells with the mental trait
against spells with the mental trait
against spells with the mental trait

item-starsong-nectar.name: Starsong Nectar
item-starsong-nectar.note: The +3 covers attack rolls (including spell attacks), initiative, Perception, all saves, and all skills. You aren't off-guard from flanking or from hidden/undetected creatures. Once per round you may spend a 1-action concentrate activation to roll two d20s and take the higher on attacks, Perception, saves, and skill checks until the start of your next turn. If you show too much caution (GM's discretion) you must save or the effect ends; you are temporarily immune for 24 hours afterward.

item-static-muscular-relay.name: Static Relay
item-static-muscular-relay.note: Ends early the moment you're hit by an attack or fail a Reflex save, whichever comes first.

item-statue-skin-salve.name: Statue Skin
item-statue-skin-salve.note: For the first 20 minutes a thin layer of stone gives resistance 3 to piercing and slashing damage. The Impersonate bonus ends early if the body is fully submerged in water. If applied to an ally instead of yourself, the whole effect belongs on their sheet.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Impersonate a statue or a creature made of stone

item-strand-of-the-seven-births.name: Hero-God's Whisper
item-strand-of-the-seven-births.note: The charm's image sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius: allies inside get +2 status to saves vs auditory effects, and enemies entering must save or be fascinated. Your own saves are unchanged.

item-sun-orchid-poultice.name: Sun Orchid Vigor
item-sun-orchid-poultice.note: Also grants 20 temporary Hit Points for the hour (temp HP, not a modifier). On application it immediately reduces your clumsy, drained, and enfeebled values by 2 - a one-time effect, not part of the duration.

item-sure-step-potion.name: Sure-Step
item-sure-step-potion.note: You can Step into difficult terrain and you aren't off-guard on uneven ground.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Balance

item-ten-days-breath.name: Ten Day's Breath
item-ten-days-breath.note: You don't need to breathe for the duration. If you spend 1 Mythic Point when you activate it, you don't need to breathe for 1 year instead.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons

item-theatrical-mutagen-greater.name: Theatrical (Greater)
item-theatrical-mutagen-greater.note: You also gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed. If you're untrained in Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance, your proficiency bonus for those checks equals your level instead of +0. Drawback: after any round in which you don't spend at least 1 action to Interact with an object, Perform, Step, or Stride, you're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

item-theatrical-mutagen-lesser.name: Theatrical (Lesser)
item-theatrical-mutagen-lesser.note: You also gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. If you're untrained in Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance, your proficiency bonus for those checks equals your level instead of +0. Drawback: after any round in which you don't spend at least 1 action to Interact with an object, Perform, Step, or Stride, you're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

item-theatrical-mutagen-major.name: Theatrical (Major)
item-theatrical-mutagen-major.note: You also gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed. If you're untrained in Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance, your proficiency bonus for those checks equals your level instead of +0. Drawback: after any round in which you don't spend at least 1 action to Interact with an object, Perform, Step, or Stride, you're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

item-theatrical-mutagen-moderate.name: Theatrical (Moderate)
item-theatrical-mutagen-moderate.note: You also gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. If you're untrained in Acrobatics, Crafting, or Performance, your proficiency bonus for those checks equals your level instead of +0. Drawback: after any round in which you don't spend at least 1 action to Interact with an object, Perform, Step, or Stride, you're off-guard until the start of your next turn.

item-therapeutic-snap-peas.name: Therapeutic Snap Peas
item-therapeutic-snap-peas.note: Only applies if you include yourself among the up to 5 chosen creatures; otherwise the mode belongs on the ally's sheet. The 4d8+10 healing is instantaneous. The alternate Beanstalk activation (10 minutes) grows a beanstalk lasting 8 hours that feeds up to 8 Large-or-smaller creatures; eating the pods heals 30 HP and allows a new save against one poison or disease — all instantaneous, no mode.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons or diseases

item-three-days-breath.name: Three Day's Breath
item-three-days-breath.note: You don't need to breathe for the duration. If you spend 1 Mythic Point when you activate it, you don't need to breathe for 30 days instead.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons

item-trackers-stew.name: Tracker's Stew
item-trackers-stew.duration: 24 hours or until your next daily preparations, whichever comes first
item-trackers-stew.note: While the stew lasts you can Cover Tracks or Track at full Speed, or do both at half Speed.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on checks to Cover Tracks and Track
to Escape or to Squeeze

item-unassuming-face-paint.name: Unassuming Face Paint
item-unassuming-face-paint.note: The same +2 item bonus applies to your Stealth DCs as well as checks. You also appear plain and inconspicuous for the duration. The mode ends immediately if you take a hostile action.

modifiers.appliesWhen: while blending into a crowd

item-valorous-coin.name: Valorous Coin
item-valorous-coin.duration: 1 hour (the bonus itself runs for 1 minute once triggered, and that minute ends the coin)
item-valorous-coin.note: The coin does nothing until you drop below a quarter of your Hit Points while wielding the affected weapon. That grants temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute (not a modifier) alongside the bonus. When the minute ends, so do all effects and the coin's remaining duration, and you're fatigued until you're healed to your maximum Hit Points.

modifiers.appliesWhen: with the affected weapon, for 1 minute after you're reduced below a quarter of your Hit Points
with the affected weapon, for 1 minute after you're reduced below a quarter of your Hit Points

item-vermin-repellent-agent-greater.name: Vermin Repellent
item-vermin-repellent-agent-greater.note: Attacking arthropods must save or become frightened (fleeing on a critical failure), then are temporarily immune for 1 minute. That effect lands on the attacker.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons

item-vermin-repellent-agent-lesser.name: Vermin Repellent
item-vermin-repellent-agent-lesser.note: While active, arthropods must save when attacking you with a melee Strike or swarm attack (Success frightened 1, Failure frightened 2, Critical Failure frightened 2 and fleeing), then are temporarily immune for 1 minute. That save affects the attacker, not you.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons

item-vermin-repellent-agent-major.name: Vermin Repellent
item-vermin-repellent-agent-major.note: Attacking arthropods must save or become frightened (fleeing on a critical failure), then are temporarily immune for 1 minute. That effect lands on the attacker.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons

item-vermin-repellent-agent-moderate.name: Vermin Repellent
item-vermin-repellent-agent-moderate.note: Attacking arthropods must save or become frightened (fleeing on a critical failure), then are temporarily immune for 1 minute. That effect lands on the attacker.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against poisons

item-vital-earth.name: Vital Earth
item-vital-earth.note: For 24 hours you don't need air or water. Anyone attempting to Administer First Aid or Treat Wounds on you doesn't need a healer's toolkit and gains a +1 item bonus to that Medicine check — that bonus applies to the healer's roll, not yours.

item-war-blood-mutagen-greater.name: War Blood Mutagen (Greater)
item-war-blood-mutagen-greater.note: Drawback: you can't voluntarily release the weapon without succeeding at a check (which ends the mutagen), and concentrate actions require a successful check or the action is lost. Disarm or other removal attempts must exceed DC 40.

modifiers.appliesWhen: attacks with the chosen melee weapon fused to your hands
against fear effects

item-war-blood-mutagen-lesser.name: War Blood Mutagen (Lesser)
item-war-blood-mutagen-lesser.note: Drawback: the weapon is fused to you - you can't voluntarily release it without succeeding at an Athletics check (DC 25), which ends the mutagen and takes a single action, and any concentrate action requires a DC 5 flat check or the action is lost. Disarm or other removal attempts must exceed DC 25.

modifiers.appliesWhen: attacks with the chosen melee weapon fused to your hands
against fear effects

item-war-blood-mutagen-major.name: War Blood Mutagen (Major)
item-war-blood-mutagen-major.note: Drawback: you can't voluntarily release the weapon without succeeding at a check (which ends the mutagen), and concentrate actions require a successful check or the action is lost. Disarm or other removal attempts must exceed DC 50.

modifiers.appliesWhen: attacks with the chosen melee weapon fused to your hands
against fear effects

item-war-blood-mutagen-moderate.name: War Blood Mutagen (Moderate)
item-war-blood-mutagen-moderate.note: Drawback: you can't voluntarily release the weapon without succeeding at a check (which ends the mutagen), and concentrate actions require a successful check or the action is lost. Disarm or other removal attempts must exceed DC 30.

modifiers.appliesWhen: attacks with the chosen melee weapon fused to your hands
against fear effects

item-warding-element-draught.name: Warding Element
item-warding-element-draught.note: The element is fixed when the draught is distilled: Blood (metal), Effervescent Gas (air), Grains (earth), Hot Peppers (fire), Spring Water (water), Wormwood (wood). Pick the matching trait when the mode is switched on.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against alchemical effects, spells, and magic effects with the draught's elemental trait
against alchemical effects, spells, and magic effects with the draught's elemental trait

item-wine-of-the-blood.name: Wine of the Blood
item-wine-of-the-blood.note: Status bonuses don't stack — a Will save against an emotion effect gets +2, not +3. Instantaneous on drinking and outside the mode: you recover 2d10 Hit Points, and the wine attempts to counteract every negative emotion effect on you (counteract rank 3, modifier +9).

modifiers.appliesWhen: against emotion effects
against emotion effects
against emotion effects

adept-benefit-amulet.name: Amulet's Abeyance
adept-benefit-amulet.duration: until the start of your next turn
adept-benefit-amulet.note: Adept Benefit (Amulet): when you use Amulet's Abeyance, you or your ally chooses one damage type dealt by the triggering attack and gains resistance 5 against it (10 at 15th level). Set the type you chose; if the ally took it instead, leave this off.

armored-resistance.name: Armored Resistance
armored-resistance.duration: while you Intercept an Attack in medium or heavy armor
armored-resistance.note: Armored Resistance: this resistance applies ONLY to the damage you take in your ally's place with Intercept Attack, and only while you wear medium or heavy armor. Switch it on when you Intercept.

axe-climber.name: Axe Climbing
axe-climber.duration: while climbing wood with an axe in each hand (or ice with two light picks)
axe-climber.note: Climbing a wooden surface with a Hatchet or Battle Axe in each hand (or ice with a Light Pick in each hand) gives you a climb Speed equal to half your Speed. You still need both legs free and can't use either axe in combat while climbing.

battle-scars.name: Battle Scars (vs. devils)
battle-scars.duration: while taking bludgeoning or slashing damage from devils or Chelaxian-allied creatures
battle-scars.note: Resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage equal to half your level, but ONLY from devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (the GM determines which creatures qualify). Leave the mode off against anything else.

break-the-suns-legs.name: Break the Sun's Legs
break-the-suns-legs.note: The stolen light is channeled to your eyes, granting you greater darkvision. The surrounding area is under a 9th-rank Darkness effect for the same minute — that part is on the battlefield, not your sheet.

canopy-predator.name: Canopy Predator
canopy-predator.duration: while moving through trees, vines, and other foliage
canopy-predator.note: A success on an Athletics check to Climb a tree or an Acrobatics check to Balance on a branch is a critical success instead, and you aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a tree.

cat-inner-fire-stoked-flame.name: Inner Fire (Stoked Flame Stance)
cat-inner-fire-stoked-flame.note: While in Stoked Flame Stance: cold and fire resistance equal to half your level. Any creature that hits you with an unarmed attack, tries to Grab or Grapple you, or otherwise touches you takes fire damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), no more than once per turn.

cat-rope-runner.name: On Ropes (Rope Runner)
cat-rope-runner.duration: while climbing or balancing on a rope or similar object
cat-rope-runner.note: Rope Runner: a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and similar objects. You aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a rope or similar object, and a success on an Athletics check to Climb or an Acrobatics check to Balance is a critical success instead.

close-formation.name: Close Formation
close-formation.duration: while wielding two fans, one in each hand
close-formation.note: Fan-dance spatial awareness: while you wield two fans, each in a different hand, you gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-1.name: Creeping Ashes 1
curse-of-creeping-ashes-1.note: Cursebound 1: weakness 2 to fire damage. Any immunity or resistance you have to fire is suppressed.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-2.name: Creeping Ashes 2
curse-of-creeping-ashes-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to fire with any fire immunity or resistance suppressed, plus swirling ash imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-creeping-ashes-3.name: Creeping Ashes 3
curse-of-creeping-ashes-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to fire is 5 + your level and any fire immunity or resistance is suppressed; the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-creeping-ashes-4.name: Creeping Ashes 4
curse-of-creeping-ashes-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): fire weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds as your limbs crumble — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-engulfing-flames.name: Engulfing Flames (cursebound)
curse-of-engulfing-flames.note: While cursebound: persistent fire damage equal to your cursebound value, and your fire immunity and resistance are suppressed.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-1.name: Headwinds 1
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-1.note: Cursebound 1: electricity weakness 2. Electricity spells and effects with extra effects against a creature wearing or holding metal treat you as wearing metal, and any immunity or resistance you have to them is suppressed.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-2.name: Headwinds 2
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): electricity weakness 2 and you count as wearing metal for electricity effects, plus blowing winds imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-3.name: Headwinds 3
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to electricity is 5 + your level, you still count as wearing metal for electricity effects, and the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-4.name: Headwinds 4
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): electricity weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and the raging winds push you back for a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

modifiers.appliesWhen: ranged attack rolls

curse-of-inevitable-rot-1.name: Inevitable Rot 1
curse-of-inevitable-rot-1.note: Cursebound 1: you gain weakness 2 to acid and poison damage.

curse-of-inevitable-rot-2.name: Inevitable Rot 2
curse-of-inevitable-rot-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to acid and poison, and a −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons. Anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds also takes −1 — that penalty is on their sheet.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against diseases and poisons

curse-of-inevitable-rot-3.name: Inevitable Rot 3
curse-of-inevitable-rot-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to acid and poison damage increases to twice your level; the −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons continues (and −1 for anyone treating you).

modifiers.appliesWhen: against diseases and poisons

curse-of-inevitable-rot-4.name: Inevitable Rot 4
curse-of-inevitable-rot-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): acid and poison weakness twice your level, and the status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons increases to −2 (as does the penalty for anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds).

modifiers.appliesWhen: against diseases and poisons

curse-of-the-living-death-1.name: Living Death 1
curse-of-the-living-death-1.note: Cursebound 1. You can be targeted by and are hurt by both vitality and void damage even if one normally has no effect on you (Heal can damage you), and any immunity or resistance you have to vitality or void is suppressed.

curse-of-the-living-death-2.name: Living Death 2
curse-of-the-living-death-2.note: Cursebound 2 (includes stage 1). Vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance you have.

curse-of-the-living-death-3.name: Living Death 3
curse-of-the-living-death-3.note: Cursebound 3. The weakness rises to 5 + your level; vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance.

curse-of-the-living-death-4.name: Living Death 4
curse-of-the-living-death-4.note: Cursebound 4. The Fortitude penalty doubles; vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-1.name: Mortal Warrior 1
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-1.note: Cursebound 1. Any immunity or resistance you have to spells is suppressed. This applies only to spells, not other magical abilities.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-2.name: Mortal Warrior 2
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-2.note: Cursebound 2 (includes stage 1). Any immunity or resistance you have to spells is still suppressed.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against spells

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-3.name: Mortal Warrior 3
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-3.note: Cursebound 3. Your weakness to spell damage equals your level; immunity or resistance to spells stays suppressed.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against spells

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-4.name: Mortal Warrior 4
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-4.note: Cursebound 4. The penalty on saves against spells doubles; immunity or resistance to spells stays suppressed.

modifiers.appliesWhen: against spells

cyclonic-ascent.name: Cyclonic Ascent
cyclonic-ascent.note: Fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 30 feet, whichever is greater, for 10 minutes. You can move upward without treating it as difficult terrain, and you can stay aloft at the end of your turn if you used an air impulse that turn. At 14th level you can also give up to five other creatures a fly Speed - that is ally-side, not on your sheet.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.duration: until the start of your next turn
deadeye.note: Until the start of your next turn you see invisible creatures and objects as silhouettes, making them merely concealed from you rather than undetected.

defiant-banner.name: Defiant Banner
defiant-banner.duration: until the start of your next turn
defiant-banner.note: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn. Allies inside your banner's aura gain the same resistance - that belongs on their sheets, not yours.

deitys-protection.name: Deity's Protection
deitys-protection.duration: until the start of your next turn
deitys-protection.note: Turn this on after you cast a domain spell. The resistance equals the rank of the domain spell you cast; domain focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.

dire-form.name: Dire Form (hybrid shape)
dire-form.duration: while you are in your hybrid shape

modifiers.appliesWhen: melee damage rolls

dire-form.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

dire-growth.name: Dire Growth (animal shape)
dire-growth.duration: while you remain in your animal shape

modifiers.appliesWhen: melee damage rolls

dire-growth.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

dissolutions-sight.name: Dissolution's Sight
dissolutions-sight.note: Once per hour. Accepting your inner darkness means no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

echoes-in-stone.name: Echoes in Stone
echoes-in-stone.duration: Until the start of your next turn
echoes-in-stone.note: Requires that you are standing on a stone or earthen surface.

echolocation.name: Echolocation
echolocation.duration: until the start of your next turn
echolocation.note: Switch this on after you Seek: until the start of your next turn you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet. You can also use this sense while you Search.

electric-counter.name: Electric Counter
electric-counter.duration: until the start of your next turn
electric-counter.note: Reaction while in Wild Winds Stance when you would take damage; the resistance also applies to the triggering damage if it was electricity. If the trigger was a melee attack, the attacker takes 3d6 damage.

energetic-meltdown.name: Moderate Backlash
energetic-meltdown.note: Moderate Backlash from Energetic Meltdown. You also lose immunity to that energy type, if you had it, until your next daily preparations. (Mild Backlash is only damage equal to your level; Severe Backlash is a burst dealing 1d6 per level, which you take in full without a save.)

extract-vow-of-nonviolence.name: Vow of Nonviolence
extract-vow-of-nonviolence.note: On a critical success the weapon swears not to hurt you; on a plain success the remaining duration also drops by 1 minute each time that weapon hits you. The resistance covers only damage dealt by that one weapon.

resistances.type: damage from the weapon that swore the vow

exude-demonic-corruption.name: Demonic Corruption
exude-demonic-corruption.duration: until the start of your next turn
exude-demonic-corruption.note: Your melee Strikes deal an extra 1d6 poison damage, and each creature that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or otherwise touches you takes 1d6 poison damage. The poison damage is 2d6 at 14th level and 3d6 at 20th.

eyes-that-see-eternity.name: Eyes that See Eternity
eyes-that-see-eternity.note: Costs 1 Mythic Point. You have the effects of Truesight (you see through illusions and magical darkness and can see invisible creatures) and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.

feat-aegis-for-the-innocent.name: Aegis for the Innocent
feat-aegis-for-the-innocent.note: An ally inside your nimbus is barriered: they have +1 status AC and enemies in/entering it must save vs your class or spell DC. While it runs, your nimbus area is halved. Your own AC is unchanged.

feat-eternal-blessing.name: Eternal Blessing
feat-eternal-blessing.duration: permanent — you may Dismiss it, and it returns automatically after 1 minute
feat-eternal-blessing.note: You are continuously surrounded by bless at a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up), radius 15 feet (it cannot be increased): you and allies inside gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

feat-tweak-appearances.name: Tweak Appearances
feat-tweak-appearances.duration: until used on the target again, the situation they were prepared for ends, or they next change their outfit
feat-tweak-appearances.note: The target you tweaked has +1 item (up to +3 at master/legendary Crafting) to Diplomacy and Performance with the chosen audience. Your own checks are unchanged.

feral-senses.name: Feral Senses
feral-senses.duration: while in your hybrid or animal shape
feral-senses.note: Werecreature archetype: these senses last only while the hybrid or animal shape is up.

field-vial-mutagenist.name: Field Vial (Mutagenist)
field-vial-mutagenist.note: Advanced Vials (Mutagenist): while a field vial you drank is in effect you have resistance to physical damage equal to half your level.

flamboyant-athlete.name: Flamboyant Athlete (Panache)
flamboyant-athlete.note: While you have panache: climb and swim Speeds equal to half your land Speed; High Jump and Long Jump DCs decrease by 10 (doesn't combine with other DC reductions); a vertical Leap covers 5 feet and a horizontal Leap 15 feet (20 feet if your Speed is at least 30).

force-of-nature.name: Force of Nature (hybrid or animal shape)
force-of-nature.duration: while you are in your hybrid or animal shape
force-of-nature.note: Fast healing 5. If you take damage from a silver weapon, the fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

form-a-flock.name: Form a Flock
form-a-flock.note: The flock also grants 25 temporary Hit Points and ends when they are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss it. Enemies in the flock aura are dazzled, and you can take the Acrid Barrage action while it lasts.

fresh-produce.name: Fresh Produce
fresh-produce.note: Only if you eat the produce yourself; you also feel full and can't eat another piece while it lasts. Resistance is 2 at 1st level and increases by 2 for every 2 levels.

gathering-moss.name: Gathering Moss
gathering-moss.duration: 1 minute or until Tenacious Stance ends
gathering-moss.note: Fast healing equal to your level (triggered when you enter Tenacious Stance). Track the healing yourself — the app has no fast-healing lane.

geomancer-dedication.name: Underground Attunement
geomancer-dedication.note: Terrain attunement after expending a slot on an earth spell underground. The other self-affecting attunements aren't tracked here: Aquatic grants a swim Speed, Sky lets you Fly 10 feet, Mountain gives resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to the spell's rank, and Plains gives temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank. Arctic, Desert, Forest and Swamp affect enemies only.

ghost-wrangler.name: Ghost Wrangler
ghost-wrangler.duration: until the start of your next turn
ghost-wrangler.note: Your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune, and you can make Strength-based skill checks against incorporeal creatures.

giants-lunge.name: Giant's Lunge
giants-lunge.note: All your melee weapons and unarmed attacks have 10-foot reach. This doesn't increase the reach of an attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with size-based reach increases such as Giant's Stature.

giants-stature.name: Giant's Stature
